Privacy Policy — Fortified Brands LLC

Last Updated: May 11, 2026

1. Introduction and Company Information

Welcome to www.livefortified.com. We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how Fortified Brands LLC ("Fortified," "we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and protects personal information when you visit our Site, purchase our products, enroll in our subscription program, or interact with our marketing.


  • Business Name: Fortified Brands LLC

  • Entity: Wyoming LLC, registered as a foreign LLC in Texas

  • Website: www.livefortified.com

  • Mailing Address (Correspondence Only): 2121 Lohmans Crossing Rd, Suite 504-106, Lakeway TX 78734

  • Contact Email: hello@livefortified.com

  • Phone: (888) 688-8351


State-specific addenda for residents of certain U.S. states are set forth in Section 5 and prevail over inconsistent general provisions to the extent of the resident's rights.

2. Information Collection & Use

2.1 Categories of Information Collected

  1. Information you provide: name, shipping and billing address, email, phone, account credentials, order and subscription history, customer-service communications, product reviews and other User Content, survey responses, and any wellness or goal information you voluntarily submit.

  2. Payment information: processed by our payment processors; we receive a tokenized reference and last-four digits. We do not retain full card numbers on our servers.

  3. Automatically collected information: device identifiers, IP address, browser type, operating system, referring URL, pages viewed, links clicked, session duration, approximate location, and cookie/tracking identifiers.

  4. From third parties: advertising and analytics partners, social platforms, affiliates, fraud-prevention vendors, and shipping/return-fulfillment vendors.


We do not intentionally collect biometric identifiers, government IDs, precise geolocation, or information about children under 13.

2.2 How We Use Information

  1. Fulfill orders, ship products, process payments, manage subscriptions, and provide customer service.

  2. Operate, maintain, secure, and improve the Site and our products.

  3. Send transactional communications (order, shipping, billing, account, cancellation, subscription reminders, security).

  4. Send marketing communications by email and SMS where you have consented (see Sections 2.5 and 2.6).

  5. Personalize content, recommendations, and offers.

  6. Measure marketing performance, conduct analytics, and prevent fraud.

  7. Comply with legal obligations, defend our rights, and enforce agreements.


We do not knowingly use personal information for automated decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects.

2.3 Health-Related Information (CPRA / Washington My Health My Data Act)

To the extent we collect information that may be considered "sensitive personal information" or "consumer health data" under applicable law (for example, information you voluntarily provide about your supplementation habits, hydration goals, or wellness preferences), we use such information only for purposes permitted by law, such as processing your orders, providing customer support, operating and improving the Website, and sending you communications consistent with your choices. We do not use such information to make medical diagnoses or clinical decisions, and you should not rely on our processing of such information as medical advice or treatment.


Washington Residents — My Health My Data Act: If you are a Washington State resident, your consumer health data is protected under the Washington My Health My Data Act (WMHMD, RCW 19.373). Consumer health data we may collect includes information you voluntarily provide about wellness goals, hydration habits, or supplementation. We use this data solely for order fulfillment and customer support. We do not sell consumer health data. We do not use geofences around health-care facilities. We do not share consumer health data for cross-context behavioral advertising without separate, opt-in consent. Washington residents have the right to: (1) confirm whether we hold your consumer health data and access it, including categories of sources and third parties with which it has been shared; (2) withdraw consent for collection or sharing; (3) request deletion (we will delete without undue delay and within 30 calendar days, including from archived and backup systems, and will notify our processors and third parties); (4) appeal a denial. To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@livefortified.com. We do not require creation of a new account to exercise these rights.


Nevada Residents: Nevada's consumer health data law affords similar rights; to exercise, contact us at hello@livefortified.com.

2.4 Selling vs. Sharing (CPRA Disclosures)

SELLING: We do not sell your personal information for monetary consideration.


SHARING FOR CROSS-CONTEXT BEHAVIORAL ADVERTISING: We share certain personal information with third parties for cross-context behavioral advertising purposes, including advertising platforms (e.g., Meta Pixel, Google Ads, TikTok Pixel), email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo), and analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics 4). The specific tools currently in use are subject to change; for an up-to-date list, contact us using the information in Section 1.


Your Right to Opt-Out: California (and other-state) residents may opt out of sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising by: (1) clicking the "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link in the footer of www.livefortified.com; (2) transmitting the Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signal, which we honor across all visitors as a matter of policy; or (3) submitting a CCPA/CPRA rights request using the contact information in Section 1.


SERVICE PROVIDERS: We disclose personal information to service providers who process data on our behalf under strict contract, including payment processors, shipping carriers, fulfillment and 3PL partners, customer-service platforms, fraud-prevention vendors, and our contract manufacturer Nutrabound for batch traceability. These disclosures are not "sales" or "sharing" under state law.


SMS Privacy: No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. SMS originator opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third party.

2.5 Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use the following categories of cookies and tracking technologies on our website:


  • Strictly necessary: Required for core site functions including checkout and account management. These cannot be disabled without affecting site functionality.

  • Functional: Remember language, region, and your preferences.

  • Analytics: Help us understand how visitors use our site so we can improve it (Google Analytics 4). You may opt out of Google Analytics tracking at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

  • Advertising / Targeting: Used to deliver and measure cross-context behavioral advertising (e.g., Meta Pixel, Google Ads, TikTok Pixel). You may manage your ad preferences through your account settings on those platforms.


You can manage cookies through our cookie preference center, displayed on first visit and accessible via "Cookie Preferences" in the Site footer. Browser-level controls (including Global Privacy Control) are honored where required by law and across all visitors as a matter of policy. You may also opt out via:


  • Network Advertising Initiative: https://optout.networkadvertising.org

  • Digital Advertising Alliance: https://optout.aboutads.info

  • Mobile: device-level "Limit Ad Tracking" / "Opt out of Ads Personalization"


Do Not Track: Browser DNT signals lack a uniform definition. We rely on the Global Privacy Control (GPC) for opt-out signaling.

2.6 SMS / Text Message Marketing

By providing your mobile number and opting in, you consent to receive recurring promotional and transactional text messages from Fortified at the number provided. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message frequency varies (approximately 4–8 messages per month promotional; transactional messages sent as needed). Message and data rates may apply.


Prior Express Written Consent. We obtain prior express written consent through a clear, conspicuous opt-in (web form, checkout checkbox, or text-to-join keyword), disclosing: (a) program description; (b) message frequency; (c) "msg & data rates may apply"; (d) HELP and STOP instructions; (e) links to these Terms and to this Privacy Policy.


Help and Opt-Out:


  • Text HELP for support information.

  • Text STOP to opt out at any time. You will receive a final confirmation message.

  • You may also email hello@livefortified.com or call (888) 688-8351 to opt out.

  • We honor opt-out requests in any reasonable manner and within ten business days, consistent with FCC revocation rules effective April 11, 2025.


Carrier Disclaimer. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Supported carriers may change.


Eligibility. You must be 18 or older and the subscriber or authorized user of the mobile number you provide. You will notify us if your mobile number changes.


Compliance. Our SMS program follows the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (47 U.S.C. § 227) and FCC rules, the CAN-SPAM Act (where applicable to electronic messages), the CTIA Short Code Monitoring Handbook, carrier guidelines, and applicable state law.

2.7 Email Marketing

Fortified sends email marketing in compliance with the CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. §§ 7701 et seq.) and applicable state law:


  1. Every commercial email identifies Fortified as sender, with a non-misleading "from" line and subject.

  2. The body discloses our physical postal address: 2121 Lohmans Crossing Rd, Suite 504-106, Lakeway TX 78734.

  3. Each email contains a functioning unsubscribe link, processed within ten business days and honored across all marketing lists.

  4. We do not use deceptive subject lines, false headers, or harvested addresses.

  5. Transactional emails (order, shipping, billing, subscription, account) are not subject to the unsubscribe requirement but follow our internal standards.

  6. To unsubscribe or for assistance, email hello@livefortified.com.

3. How We Disclose Information

  1. Service providers and processors under written contracts limiting their processing — payment processors, shipping carriers, fulfillment and 3PL partners, email and SMS service providers, customer-service platforms, analytics and advertising vendors, fraud-prevention vendors, and Nutrabound for batch traceability.

  2. Advertising partners (as described in Section 2.4).

  3. Affiliates and successors in any merger, acquisition, financing, or sale of all or a portion of our business or assets.

  4. Legal and safety purposes — to comply with law, respond to lawful requests, or protect rights, safety, and property.

  5. With your direction (for example, when you share content publicly).

4. Security; Retention; International Transfers

4.1 Security

We use commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards consistent with the New York SHIELD Act and analogous state security laws. No method of internet transmission is perfectly secure.

4.2 Retention

We retain personal information as long as needed to provide products and services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Subscription consent records are retained at least three years or one year after cancellation, whichever is longer.

4.3 International Visitors

Fortified ships within the United States only. If you visit the Site from outside the United States, your information will be processed in the United States, which may have data-protection laws different from those of your country.

5. State-Specific Privacy Rights Addenda

The addenda below supplement this Privacy Policy. To the extent of any conflict, the addendum prevails for the relevant resident.

5.1 California (CCPA / CPRA, CalOPPA, Shine the Light, Eraser Law, Financial Incentives)

Categories collected in the last 12 months: identifiers; commercial information; internet/network activity; geolocation (approximate); audio/visual (when you submit reviews or contact us); inferences. Categories disclosed for a business purpose include identifiers, commercial information, and internet/network activity (to service providers). Categories shared/sold for cross-context behavioral advertising include identifiers and internet/network activity.


Your rights as a California resident: (1) right to know/access; (2) right to delete; (3) right to correct; (4) right to opt out of sale/sharing; (5) right to limit use of sensitive personal information (we do not use sensitive PI beyond permitted purposes); (6) right of non-discrimination/non-retaliation; (7) right to data portability. To exercise, email hello@livefortified.com, call (888) 688-8351, or use the "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information" link in the Site footer. We honor GPC. We will respond within 45 days (extendable by 45). For sensitive requests we may require additional identity verification.


Shine the Light (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.83): California residents may request once per year a list of categories of personal information disclosed to third parties for their direct-marketing purposes during the prior year. Email hello@livefortified.com.


Eraser Law (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §§ 22580–22582): California users under 18 with a registered account may request removal of content they posted. Email hello@livefortified.com.


Financial Incentives: If you enroll in our Subscribe & Save program, you receive a discount in exchange for ongoing data processing necessary to operate the subscription. The estimated value of this incentive equals the price differential between the one-time and subscription prices. You may withdraw at any time by cancelling your subscription.


Authorized agents must provide signed permission and verification.

5.2 Texas (TDPSA — Tex. Bus. & Com. Code Ch. 541)

Texas residents have rights to: (1) confirm processing; (2) access personal data; (3) correct inaccuracies; (4) delete; (5) portability; (6) opt out of targeted advertising, sale of personal data, and profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects. We honor universal opt-out signals, including GPC, effective January 1, 2025. We process sensitive data only with your affirmative consent. We do not sell sensitive personal data. We do not sell biometric data. Response window: 45 days, extendable by 45. Appeal: 60 days. If we deny your appeal, we will provide the online method to contact the Texas Attorney General. Enforcement is by the Texas Attorney General; there is no private right of action.

5.3 Other State Privacy Laws

Residents of the following states (each in effect as of May 11, 2026) have, at a minimum: (1) right to confirm/access; (2) right to correct (Utah and Iowa do not require correction); (3) right to delete; (4) right to portability; (5) right to opt out of targeted advertising and sale; and, in most states, opt out of profiling with legal/similar significant effect. Sensitive data is processed only with consent (Utah/Iowa: with notice and opt-out). To exercise, email hello@livefortified.com or call (888) 688-8351. We will respond within 45 days (extendable by 45) and offer an appeal where required.


Covered states: Virginia (VCDPA), Colorado (CPA), Connecticut (CTDPA), Utah (UCPA), Oregon (OCPA), Montana (MTCDPA as amended by SB 297), Iowa (ICDPA), Indiana (ICDPA), Tennessee (TIPA), Delaware (DPDPA), New Hampshire (NHDPA), New Jersey (NJDPA), Nebraska (NDPA), Maryland (MODPA — enforcement begins April 1, 2026), Minnesota (MCDPA), Rhode Island (RIDTPPA), Kentucky (KCDPA).


Universal Opt-Out / GPC honored for: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Texas, Oregon, Montana, Delaware, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Minnesota, Maryland, and any other state where required as of the date a request is made.


Minnesota-specific: right to a list of specific third parties to which personal data has been disclosed; right to question profiling outcomes and require human review of profiling decisions producing legal/similar significant effects.


Oregon-specific: right to a list of specific third parties to which personal data has been disclosed; sale of precise geolocation prohibited; sale of personal data of consumers under 16 with actual knowledge or willful disregard is prohibited.


Maryland (MODPA) — stricter rules: Sale of sensitive data is prohibited regardless of consent. Collection of sensitive data must be "strictly necessary" to provide the requested product or service. We do not sell sensitive data and process sensitive data only as strictly necessary. Targeted advertising and data sales involving consumers we know or should know are under 18 are prohibited.


Rhode Island (RIDTPPA): notably low applicability thresholds (35,000 consumers, or 10,000 if >20% revenue from sales of personal data); AG sole enforcer; no private right of action.


Florida (FDBR): narrow scope. Fortified does not currently meet the FDBR's applicability thresholds. Florida residents nonetheless retain the rights described in this Policy as a matter of policy.


No-discrimination: Across all states, we do not deny goods or services, charge different prices, or provide different quality based on the exercise of privacy rights, except where permitted (e.g., a financial-incentive program operated with notice).

5.4 New York (SHIELD Act, GBL §§ 349–350)

We maintain reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards under the SHIELD Act and disclose materially accurate information about products and prices, consistent with GBL §§ 349 and 350.

5.5 Illinois (BIPA) and Texas (CUBI — Tex. Bus. & Com. Code § 503.001)

Fortified does not collect, store, or use biometric identifiers or biometric information. These laws are referenced for completeness; they do not currently impose obligations on Fortified.

6. Children's Privacy (COPPA)

Fortified's Site and products are intended for adults. The Site is not directed to children under 13. Consistent with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA, 15 U.S.C. §§ 6501 et seq.) and applicable state minor-protection laws (Maryland MODPA's expanded protections for individuals under 18, Connecticut's age-appropriate-design code, Oregon HB 2008's prohibition on sale of personal data with knowledge of consumers under 16, and the Texas SCOPE Act to the extent applicable):


  1. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

  2. If you believe a child under 13 has provided information to us, please contact hello@livefortified.com and we will delete it.

  3. We do not engage in targeted advertising to consumers we know or should know are under 18 and we do not sell their personal data.

  4. We do not require account creation by anyone under 18 and we restrict subscription enrollment to adults.

7. Your Rights and How to Exercise Them

To submit any privacy request — access, correction, deletion, portability, opt-out of sale/sharing, opt-out of profiling, withdraw consent, or appeal a denial:


  • Email: hello@livefortified.com

  • Phone: (888) 688-8351

  • Mail: Fortified Brands LLC, Attn: Privacy, 2121 Lohmans Crossing Rd, Suite 504-106, Lakeway TX 78734


We will verify your identity before processing rights requests involving sensitive data. We will respond within the timeframes required by applicable state law (generally 45 days, extendable by 45). You may appeal any denial; if we deny your appeal, we will provide the contact method for your state attorney general.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or prominent Site notice. The "Last Updated" date above will reflect any changes.

9. Contact

Privacy questions and requests:


  • Email: hello@livefortified.com

  • Phone: (888) 688-8351

  • Mail: Fortified Brands LLC, Attn: Privacy, 2121 Lohmans Crossing Rd, Suite 504-106, Lakeway TX 78734

Refund Policy

Last Updated: May 11, 2026

1. Money-Back Guarantee — No Return Required

If you are not satisfied with your Fortified product for any reason, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we will refund the purchase price. You do not need to return the product. Keep, share, or discard it.


  • Strict Cutoff: Refund requests submitted after 30 days from the delivery date cannot be honored.

  • Eligibility: This guarantee applies to product purchased directly from livefortified.com. Marketplace or third-party retailer purchases must be returned under that retailer's policy.

  • Limits: Fortified reserves the right to deny repeated abusive refund requests consistent with applicable law.

2. How to Request a Refund

  • Email: hello@livefortified.com with your order number and a brief note.

  • Phone: (888) 688-8351 during business hours.

3. Refund Processing

  • Method: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.

  • Timeline: Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days after approval. Bank posting times vary.

4. Subscriptions

A money-back refund on a subscription order does not, by itself, cancel future deliveries. To cancel a subscription, follow the Cancellation Policy. Refunds do not extend cancellation deadlines for subsequent orders.

5. Damaged or Defective Items

If your product arrives damaged or defective, contact us immediately at hello@livefortified.com. We will replace defective product at no cost or issue a refund.

6. Shipping & Delivery (Cross-Reference)

For lost-in-transit shipments, shipping carriers, and risk-of-loss policies, see the Shipping Policy.

Shipping Policy

Last Updated: May 11, 2026

1. Where We Ship

Fortified ships within the United States only — all 50 states and the District of Columbia. We do not ship internationally.

2. Order Processing

  • Timeframe: Orders typically ship within 1–3 business days from our fulfillment partner.

  • Closures: Our logistics center is closed on weekends and public holidays; orders placed during those times are processed on the next business day.

  • Subscriptions: Auto-Ship orders ship on your scheduled cadence (every 30, 60, or 90 days).

3. Delivery Times and Carriers

  • Domestic: Standard ground service generally arrives within 3–7 business days, depending on destination. Expedited service is available at checkout where offered. Carriers and rates might vary.

  • Shipping Charges and Taxes: Calculated at checkout. Sales tax is charged in jurisdictions where Fortified has nexus.

4. Shipping & Delivery Responsibility

  • Secure Location: Please ensure your shipping address is secure. We recommend designating a safe delivery location with your carrier.

  • Stolen/Missing Items: Once a package is marked as "delivered" by the carrier (USPS, UPS, etc.), Fortified is not responsible for stolen or missing items.

4.1 Customer Responsibility After Delivery

Once a package is marked as "delivered" by the carrier, all risk of loss, theft, weather damage, or misdelivery transfers to you. We strongly recommend you request signature confirmation for delivery and designate a secure delivery location with your carrier. Fortified Brands LLC assumes no liability for packages stolen or lost after carrier delivery.

5. Lost or Damaged Shipments

If a shipment is lost in transit (not marked delivered) or arrives damaged, contact us within 14 business days of the scheduled delivery date at hello@livefortified.com. We will work with you and the carrier to resolve.

6. Address Accuracy

You are responsible for an accurate shipping address. Reshipments due to incorrect addresses may be charged.

Cancellation Policy

Last Updated: May 11, 2026


We offer both one-time purchases and subscription (Auto-Ship) options. This policy explains how each works and how you can cancel or change your order.

1. Purchase Options

1.1 One-Time Purchases

  • A one-time purchase is a single order that is not set to renew automatically.

  • You will be charged once for the products in your cart, plus applicable taxes and shipping at checkout.

1.2 Subscription / Auto-Ship Purchases

  • A Subscription or Auto-Ship purchase means your selected product(s) will be billed and shipped to you on a recurring schedule (every 30, 60, or 90 days) until you cancel.

  • The price, billing interval, and products included in your subscription will be clearly displayed at checkout before you complete your order.

  • By enrolling in Auto-Ship, you authorize Fortified Brands LLC to charge your chosen payment method on the selected schedule until you cancel, in accordance with our Terms of Service.

  • Express Affirmative Consent: You provide express affirmative consent to the recurring charges by clicking the clearly labeled subscription checkbox or button at checkout. We do not pre-check the consent box. Your consent to the subscription is separate from your consent to the underlying purchase.

  • Post-Purchase Confirmation: Immediately after enrollment, we send a confirmation email with the subscription terms, cancellation instructions, your next billing date, and a direct link to your account portal at livefortified.com.

  • Renewal Reminders: We send a renewal reminder before each billing date. For material changes to pricing, cadence, or product, we provide clear advance notice and obtain affirmative consent where required by law.

2. Order Cancellation (All Purchase Types)

We understand that plans can change, and we aim to accommodate cancellation requests whenever possible. However, due to our fast processing and shipping timelines, the following cancellation policy applies:

2.1 Cancellation Window

  • Orders may only be canceled at least 48 hours prior to processing and shipment.

  • Because orders can enter processing before a shipping label is created, we strongly recommend submitting any cancellation request as soon as possible after placing your order.

2.2 Weekend Orders

  • Our business is closed on Saturdays and Sundays, and we cannot process cancellations over the weekend.

  • If your order is scheduled to process or ship over the weekend, your cancellation request must be submitted no later than the Friday before, during our normal business hours.

2.3 Processed Orders / Tracking Issued

  • Once an order has been processed and/or a tracking number has been issued, we are unable to cancel the order.

  • At that point, the order will ship to the address provided at checkout.

2.4 Returns After Shipment

If your order has already shipped, you may request a refund in accordance with our Refund Policy. Refund eligibility, timelines, and any applicable terms will be governed solely by the Refund Policy.

3. Subscription / Auto-Ship Management

This section summarizes your options; in case of any conflict, the Subscription and Auto-Renewal section of our Terms of Service controls.

3.1 How to Cancel or Modify a Subscription

You may cancel or modify your subscription at any time before your next scheduled billing date through your account portal:


Online (Self-Serve — Preferred):


  • Log in to your account at www.livefortified.com.

  • Go to My Subscriptions (or Account → Auto-Ship Settings).

  • Select the subscription you want to change.

  • Choose Cancel Subscription or update your frequency, quantity, or products.


The portal cancellation flow is at least as simple as the enrollment flow and does not require email, phone, retention agents, or chat. Cancellation processes immediately on submission, and you will receive a cancellation confirmation by email.


By Email or Phone (Alternative):


  • Email hello@livefortified.com with the subject line "Cancel Subscription" or "Modify Subscription." Include your name, account email, and subscription or order number.

  • Call (888) 688-8351 during posted business hours and request cancellation or changes.

3.2 Effective Date of Subscription Cancellation

  • If you cancel before your next scheduled billing date, no further recurring charges will be processed for that subscription.

  • If you cancel after a recurring order has already been processed and/or a tracking number has been issued, that order will be fulfilled and shipped, and the cancellation will take effect for future renewal cycles.

  • For orders that have shipped, our Refund Policy will apply.

3.3 Saving Offers During Cancellation

If we present a discount or save offer during the portal cancellation flow, the click-to-cancel link is continuously displayed and operative; selecting it cancels the subscription without requiring you to consider or reject the offer.

3.4 Retention of Consent

We retain proof of your subscription consent for at least three years, or one year after cancellation, whichever is longer.

4. Changing Purchase Options (One-Time vs. Subscription)

4.1 Upgrading from One-Time to Subscription

  • You may convert a future purchase to a subscription at checkout or through your account dashboard.

  • Changing to a subscription will not retroactively alter charges for past one-time orders.

4.2 Downgrading from Subscription to One-Time

  • You may cancel your subscription at any time and then place future orders as one-time purchases.

  • Cancelling a subscription does not affect any order that has already been processed or shipped.

5. Price Changes and Notifications

5.1 Price Changes

  • We may change subscription prices or discounts from time to time.

  • If we make a material change to your subscription price or billing terms, we will notify you in advance by email and give you the opportunity to cancel before the new price takes effect.

5.2 Promotions and Subscribe & Save

  • Promotions or discounts tied to a purchase option (for example, Subscribe & Save) may apply only while your subscription remains active and in good standing.

  • If you cancel or modify your subscription, associated promotional pricing may end and standard pricing may apply to future orders.

6. Regulatory Compliance

This Cancellation Policy is drafted to comply with the Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act (ROSCA, 15 U.S.C. §§ 8401–8405), Section 5 of the FTC Act, the 1973 Negative Option Rule, and all state automatic-renewal laws in force, including California Bus. & Prof. Code §§ 17600–17606 as amended by AB 2863 (effective July 1, 2025), as well as comparable laws in New York, Vermont, Illinois, Colorado, Tennessee, Virginia, Minnesota, South Carolina, Utah, and Massachusetts.

7. Contact for Purchase & Cancellation Questions

If you have questions about your purchase option, subscription status, or cancellation, contact us at:


  • Email: hello@livefortified.com

  • Phone: (888) 688-8351

Terms of Service

Last Updated: May 11, 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms & Scope

By accessing or using https://www.livefortified.com (the "Site") or purchasing any product from Fortified Brands LLC ("Fortified," "we," "us," or "our"), you agree to be bound by this Agreement. You acknowledge you are at least 18 years old (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, if higher). This Agreement incorporates by reference our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, Shipping Policy, Cancellation Policy, and Contact Information.

1.1 Geographic Restriction

This website and its products are directed only to U.S. consumers. Fortified ships within the United States only — all 50 states and the District of Columbia — and does not ship internationally. This Site is not directed to consumers outside the United States.

1.2 SMS & Email Marketing Consent

By signing up for texts and emails, you agree to our Privacy Policy and to receive recurring autodialed marketing messages from Fortified at the mobile number or email used at opt-in. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help and STOP to cancel. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Detailed SMS and email program terms are set forth in our Privacy Policy.

2. Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Business Model

Fortified Brands LLC is a Wyoming limited liability company with its principal office at 2121 Lohmans Crossing Rd, Suite 504-106, Lakeway TX 78734, registered as a foreign LLC in Texas. We operate as a Direct-to-Consumer company. This ensures direct customer communication and clear responsibility for marketing claims.

3. Account Responsibility & Reviews

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.

3.1 No Guarantee of Results

Any statements made by customers, influencers, or other third parties about their experiences with our Products (including testimonials, reviews, ratings, before-and-after photos, or social media posts) reflect their individual opinions and experiences only. Results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed. You should not rely on such statements as typical, and they do not constitute medical advice, performance guarantees, or a warranty of any kind.

3.2 Prohibition of Fake, AI-Generated, or Paid Reviews (FTC Compliance)

Fortified Brands LLC does not knowingly accept, publish, or promote fake, false, AI-generated, or misleading reviews or testimonials, consistent with the FTC's 2024 Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule (16 CFR Part 465). All reviews and testimonials must:


  • Reflect the honest opinion and actual experience of the person giving the review;

  • Not misrepresent that the reviewer exists, had actual experience with the Product, or is someone other than who they claim to be;

  • Clearly and conspicuously disclose any material connection to the business (e.g., employee, relative, affiliate, or compensation arrangement).


We do not compensate reviewers or solicit reviews conditioned on expressing a particular sentiment. If you discover a fake, AI-generated, or deceptive review on our Website or social channels, report it to hello@livefortified.com and we will investigate and remove it promptly.

3.3 Influencer, Affiliate & Endorsement Compliance (overview)

Any person receiving compensation from Fortified Brands LLC (affiliate commission, sponsorship, free product, rebate, or other valuable consideration) who makes statements about our Products must clearly and conspicuously disclose the material connection in close proximity to the review or endorsement using explicit language such as "I received compensation," "Paid partnership," "#ad," or "#sponsored." The disclosure must appear before the endorsement and before any "more" cut on platforms that truncate captions. Detailed obligations for affiliates and influencers are set forth in Section 10.

4. Medical Disclaimer, Safety & Assumption of Risk

4.4 Vitamin K2 / Blood-Thinner Warning — Everyday SKUs Only

Fortified Everyday Salty Orange and Fortified Everyday Salty Watermelon contain Menaquinone-7 (Vitamin K2). Vitamin K2 can interfere with warfarin (Coumadin, Jantoven) and other vitamin-K antagonist anticoagulants by reducing their effectiveness. Even low doses of MK-7 are clinically significant. If you take warfarin or any anticoagulant, consult your healthcare provider before using this product and maintain consistent vitamin-K intake.

4.5 Vitamin D Upper Limit — Everyday SKUs Only

Each Everyday stick provides 25 mcg (1,000 IU) of Vitamin D3 (130% DV). The Tolerable Upper Intake Level for adults is 4,000 IU/day (100 mcg) of Vitamin D. Do not exceed the recommended serving without consulting a healthcare provider, especially if you take other Vitamin D–containing supplements.
